title: Dogs help travelers – level 2
paragraphs: Istanbul Airport now has therapy dogs to help travelers relax before flights. Some people are anxious before flying and therapy dogs are a great help.

Passengers like Anastasia Podmazova welcome the service, and they find comfort in petting dogs like Kuki. Because of positive feedback, the airport is thinking of having five more dogs. That would make ten dogs altogether.
Dog expert Murat Cengiz Koca said that the trained dogs stayed calm and didn’t react to sounds or people.

words.d: to touch an animal because you like it
